title: 17th Sitting of Second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/17/2/2026).
First reading of the bill to amend the Utility Regulatory Authority Act (Law No. 26/2020), submitted on behalf of the government by Vilufushi MP Hassan Waheed.
First reading of the Bill on Leasing Uninhabited Islands and Lagoons, submitted on behalf of the government by Thinadhoo North MP Saudhulla Hilmy.

First reading of the resolution by Hulhumale South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed calling on the government to immediately halt the sale of permanent residence permits to foreigners under the "Maldives Pearl Residence Programme" and disclose all related agreements to Parliament.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Utility Regulatory Authority Act (Law No. 26/2020), submitted on behalf of the government by Vilufushi MP Hassan Waheed.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir noting that many people are being politically dismissed from state-owned companies under the name of downsizing, to establish Parliament's view on the matter.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominee for Ambassador to the Kingdom of Belgium and the European Union.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominee for Non-Resident Ambassador to the Kingdom of Bahrain.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting introduced two government bills and the Pearl Residence resolution, debated the Utility Regulatory Authority amendment and the SOE dismissals resolution, and took two ambassador nominee reports.
